records.source: Iyer et al. 2018 (CANDELS GOODS-S, Dense Basis SFHs)
records.run: combined direct fits and SFR-M* trajectories

axes.xDefinition: log10 stellar mass from Dense Basis SED fitting (FSPS, Chabrier IMF)
axes.yDefinition: log10 SFR from Dense Basis SED fitting: effectively instantaneous SFR at the epoch of observation (direct fits) or at the epoch of interest along the reconstructed SFH (trajectories)

representation.equation: log SFR = (0.80 - 0.017 t) log M* - (6.487 - 0.039 t), t = age of the universe in Gyr (Eq. 2)

scatter.meaning: observed scatter of the combined (direct + trajectory) sample at z=3-6 (0.27-0.28 dex; 0.38 at z=1, 0.29 at z=2), not an uncertainty of the curve

selection.population: galaxies of the CANDELS GOODS-S catalogue at 0.5<z<6 (17,873 after removing stars, X-ray AGN and chi2>50 fits), high-confidence trajectories (combined uncertainty < 1 dex), linear fit with iterative robust outlier rejection; no UVJ or sSFR pre-selection
selection.warning: The relation is a linear fit at z=1,2,3,4,5,6 whose slope and normalization are then fitted as linear functions of cosmic time (valid 1<=z<=6). Combines galaxies observed at each epoch with galaxies observed at later epochs propagated back along their SFHs. The mass range is not stated as a validity range: the lower end 7.38 is the lowest 10th-percentile stellar mass probed by trajectories (z=6, Table of lowest masses probed); the upper end 10.5 is where the paper says earlier studies find a turnover, 'most of our galaxies fall below this mass range'. The paper finds this relation 0.2-0.4 dex below Speagle+14 and notes the SED-based SFRs are not comparable with UV+IR SFRs.

provenance.citation: Iyer et al. 2018, ApJ 866, 120 (arXiv:1809.04099), Eq. 2 and Table of slope/normalization

records.notes: Coefficients parsed from the arXiv source. Verification: Eq. 2 at t(z=1..6) in the paper's flat LCDM (H0=70, Om=0.3) reproduces the paper's own total slope m and normalization c9 (log SFR at 1e9 Msun) at z=1-6 within 0.51 sigma for all 12 numbers (differences <= 0.04 dex).

definitions.sfrIndicator: Dense Basis SED fitting of 0.3-8 micron photometry
definitions.sfrTimescaleBasis: 'Fits to the galaxy SEDs ... provide us with both the Stellar Masses and effectively instantaneous Star Formation Rates at the epoch of observation'
definitions.sfrStatisticNote: linear fit to individual galaxies with iterative robust outlier exclusion (Holland & Welsch 1977), not a median or mean
